_comment: The verification sample (plan section 6.1; Heejin, 14 October 2026): 150 assembled issues, stratified by decade and genre, drawn once with a fixed seed by scripts/draw_verification_sample.py; read on the workbench and marked verified record by record; every fifth issue in the reading order is read by a second reader too. The assembly's accuracy is s11_corrections_audit.py --sample over these issues.
strata: decade x genre class (the plan's eight; format unknown in the archive's metadata)
